_about: Where each climbing route runs on the 3D model, from its low end toward the summit (the summit is added at the end).
Each step is either a named point [lat, lon, "what it is"] or {"osm": "<way name>"}, which follows that
OpenStreetMap line (from scripts/hero/osm-routes.overpass; cached in .cache/osm-routes.json), lowest end first.
{"osm": ..., "above": 1900} keeps only the part of the line above that elevation in metres.
Named features (Illumination Saddle, Pulpit Rock, Horseshoe Rock, the glaciers, ridges and headwalls) are
OpenStreetMap positions; points between them are placed by hand on those features, so the lines are
approximate: right face, right features, not a survey of the exact line.
leuthold: upper Reid Glacier, below the couloir
the couloir, between Yocum Ridge and Hawkins Cliffs
summit ridge, west of the top
north-face: between the Coe and Eliot glaciers
